replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes with complex problems or deadlines. My high agreeableness helps me seek help or collaborative practice, which reduces pressure.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not directly for math, but I used note-taking apps and calculators with features like step-by-step explanations.
